Second mature magnolia in the same bed, roughly 6 m SSE of the first, same distance from the lane; position along the bed is +/- 3 m.

Third life ring, on the south pool fence at the base of the deck spur, immediately pool-side of the strelitzia (also in IMG_2206, IMG_2208).

Tall dark-green lamp post with lantern on the south edge of the E-W lane, at the east side of the mouth of the path that runs SSE, just NW of the corner of the house at the bottom of the patch. Also in IMG_2196 (right foreground) and IMG_2220.

Steps with two long sloping steel handrails going down into the water from the north-east corner of the deck. Placed in the short straight-sided stub on the north-east of the surveyed pool outline, which is the only part of the outline that matches (the aerial shows a dark curved mark in the same stub). Also the rail at the near-left edge of south-pool-02 and the left-hand pair of rails in IMG_2188.

Two-hoop steel ladder on the deck tongue that pushes into the pool from the west (the notch in the west side of the surveyed outline), on its south edge about 0.5 m back from the tip. Rays from IMG_2188 (compass 171 deg) and from south-pool-02 both land within 0.5 m of this point; also the far-centre ladder in south-pool-01.

Steel ladder at the south end of the straight edge on the east side of the pointed deck tongue that enters the pool from the south (the V notch in the surveyed outline), i.e. the south-west corner of the south-east lobe. Seen far-left in south-pool-02, near-left in south-pool-01 and left of the pump box in IMG_2188; the three rays agree to about 1 m.

White louvred box about 1.5 m long with a blue notice on it, standing on the deck at the base of the pointed south tongue, just behind (south of) the V of the pool edge. Position from rays in south-pool-02, south-pool-01 and IMG_2188, which agree to under 1 m; it is on deck, about 1 m outside the water outline.

Orange life ring on a post at the north-east edge of the deck, beside the frosted screen by the steps. Ray from IMG_2188 (left of the frosted panels) crossed with the deck edge read from the aerial; the ray from south-pool-01 (ring at far right) lands about 1 m east of this.

Orange life ring on a post at the south-south-east edge of the deck, left of the ladder as seen from the north. Rays from IMG_2188 and south-pool-02 cross the aerial deck edge within 0.5 m of each other here. One of the two tall curved shower posts stands just behind it.

Orange life ring on a post at the west edge of the deck, next to frosted glass panels and just beyond the base of the west ladder tongue. Rays from south-pool-02, south-pool-01 and IMG_2188 spread over about 1.5 m; placed on the deck edge read from the aerial.

Very large palm with a thick trunk and heavy crown (Canary type), standing beyond the north end of the terrace west of the pool, by the cross path. In south-pool-01 it is about 6 deg right of the far end of that terrace; the two ways of fixing the bearing (pool fittings, and the terrace end) give rays that pass either side of the one big dark crown on the aerial, about 5 m across and centred here after adding 1 m to x. The palm-frond shadow across the foreground lawn of south-pool-03 fits a big palm at this spot.
